tools.name: PFAT — Personal Finance Advisor Tool
tools.description: Add transactions by hand, paste text, or import CSV, PDF, and scanned statements or app screenshots. Get a money-in, money-out HUD, a paycheck plan, a 30-day look ahead, and a plain-language checkup. Everything stays on your device.
tools.page_description: See where your money goes. Add transactions by hand, paste text, or import bank, card, and investment statements (CSV, PDF, scanned PDFs, and screenshots, read on your device), then get a money-in, money-out HUD, a paycheck plan, a 30-day look ahead, and a plain-language checkup. Everything stays on your device.
